argv: i=0; while [ "$i" -lt 60 ]; do status=$(docker inspect -f "{{.State.Health.Status}}" openmetadata_server 2>/dev/null || true); if [ "$status" = healthy ]; then docker inspect -f "{{.Name}} {{.State.Status}} {{.State.Health.Status}}" openmetadata_server; exit 0; fi; i=$((i+1)); sleep 2; done; docker inspect -f "{{json .State.Health}}" openmetadata_server; exit 1
